name: browser-extension
description: Chrome/Firefox WebExtension for js-bridge-mcp: keeps a page's connection alive across reloads/navigations, and exposes the extension itself as a persistent tool-provider channel.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: BUILD_TARGET=chrome vite build --config build/vite.background.config.ts && BUILD_TARGET=chrome node build/build-content-scripts.mjs && BUILD_TARGET=chrome vite build --config build/vite.popup.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: BUILD_TARGET=firefox vite build --config build/vite.background.config.ts && BUILD_TARGET=firefox node build/build-content-scripts.mjs && BUILD_TARGET=firefox vite build --config build/vite.popup.config.ts
